v9-host-source.description: Canonical V9 host source template (Vite input for build:live:chart). Not a URL, but the single source from which v9-host-built and v9-host-public are generated, so a module dropped here is dropped from every host surface at the next build. Required-module enforcement here is the earliest and cheapest place to catch capability loss.

v9-host-built.description: Generated V9 host build output at chart/dist-v9/index.html. FastAPI selects it for /chart/index.html and mounts /chart/dist-v9. Same required set as the source, with the Vite source entry ./main.jsx replaced by the built bundle.

v9-host-public.description: Homepage web-root mirror of the V9 host build, served directly by nginx at /chart/dist-v9/index.html. In the image this path is overwritten from the chart_assets build stage, so it must carry the identical contract to v9-host-built.

legacy-host-source.description: Legacy monolithic host shell retained only as the A10 control-harvest source. It is de-routed under A14.3: no CHART_ROOT_FILES allowlist entry, no Docker publication, and runtime probes require /chart/legacy-index.html to return 404. No module contract is asserted against this retained source.

legacy-host-public.description: Former homepage web-root copy of the legacy host shell. Removed under A14.3 so the public /chart/legacy-index.html route is not served; A10 retention applies only to chart v 1.4/chart/legacy-index.html.

multichart-embed-source.description: Owned production multichart panel shell chart/multichart-prod/chart-embed.html, mounted by FastAPI at /chart/multichart-prod and loaded in MultichartGrid iframes. Embed-lite by design: the three host-only modules loaded through __loadHostOnlyScript on the V9 host (compare-overlay, screenshot-manager, alert-system) must never appear here. indicator-replay-ui-sync IS required on embed per the required-global audit.

multichart-embed-public.description: Homepage web-root mirror of the production panel shell, served by nginx and overwritten in the image from the chart_assets build stage. Identical contract to multichart-embed-source; the two must stay byte-equal.

dist-legacy-fallback.description: Bundled legacy client build chart/dist/index.html. Its 26 script tags point at minified bundle chunks, so it references no path matching /chart/chart.js or /chart/modules/*: a name-matching module assertion structurally cannot verify it and requiredModules is therefore deliberately empty. Verification for this role must be bundle-content or runtime-symbol based. The working-tree artifact is stale, and its shell row proves from source that neither the /chart/dist mount nor the /chart/index.html second-choice fallback is active in production.

admin-dist.description: Talaria admin-dashboard lineage (HeroUI Vite source, its build output, and superseded admin pages not routed through CHART_ROOT_FILES). The served admin monolith at chart/admin-dashboard.html is inventoried under admin-root-shell.

admin-root-shell.description: Routed chart-root admin monolith (admin-dashboard.html). CHART_ROOT_FILES allowlist plus the dedicated @app.get handler; loads no chart.js and asserts no correctness-class exposure modules.

backtest-root-shell.description: Routed chart-root standard backtesting shell (backtesting.html). CHART_ROOT_FILES allowlist at api_server.py:26925; no chart engine and no exposure-class module obligation.

propfirm-root-shell.description: Routed chart-root prop-firm challenge shell (propfirm-backtest.html). CHART_ROOT_FILES allowlist at api_server.py:26926; no chart engine and no build stamp series.

pointer-stub.description: Pointer/redirect documents with zero script tags that exist only to send a reader or an old bookmark to the real surface. Both are in the CHART_ROOT_FILES allowlist and therefore routed, but neither is a chart runtime, so no module contract applies. Empty stampSeries: this role carries no stamp.

sandbox-multichart.description: Hand-maintained non-production multichart sandbox rig under chart/multichart and its committed homepage mirror. chart-host.html loads the real chart engine, so this is a chart-capable shell with no owner and no build stamp. No module contract is asserted while the retain-or-remove decision is open. Empty stampSeries: this role carries no stamp.

browser-harness.description: Browser-integration test harness pages that drive real product modules or bridges from a local harness server. They are routed in production only because whole directories (modules, multichart-prod) are mounted and copied; they are not product surfaces and assert no product module contract. Empty stampSeries: this role carries no stamp.

frozen-evidence.description: Immutable frozen A/B baseline evidence under multichart-prod/harness/frozen. Its value depends on never changing, so requiredModules is deliberately empty and its stamp must never be refreshed: asserting the current module set here would demand mutating immutable evidence to make the build green. Its production reachability is accidental and is closed by route denial, not by editing the snapshot.

public-test-fixture.description: Test fixtures from the M21-W6 fixture tree that are live on a public web root. DECLARED BUT UNUSED in this inventory: none of the four fixture documents loads a chart-engine asset (preflight-host.html, preflight-iframe.html, lwc-proto.html and lwc-proto-dryrun-client.html carry inline script only), so under Ruling 5 they are narrow-inventory-ineligible and appear only in scripts/servable-surface-inventory.json with kind fixture, where their removal-pending and denied-route-pending dispositions are recorded. Empty stampSeries: this role carries no stamp.

image-built-export.description: Working-tree copies of chart shells under homepage/out. That directory is a stale local Next static export, is git-ignored, and is excluded from both Docker build contexts by the root .dockerignore rule **/out; the homepage image regenerates the export with npm run build. This role asserts nothing against the working tree — its contract is verified against the built image, which is what status image-verified records. Empty stampSeries: this role carries no stamp.

Not published by homepage/Dockerfile:81-89. Its stale 20260724b59 stamp therefore cannot reach a user.
